test_title: PYST 14: SSC CHSL - General Awareness (Held on: 14 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements regarding coal is NOT correct?

options.text: Anthracite is the highest quality hard coal.
Coal that has been buried deep and subjected to increased temperatures is bituminous coal.
Lignite is a low-grade brown coal, which is soft with high moisture content.
Metallurgical coal is high grade lignite coal which has a special value for smelting iron in blast furnaces.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Metallurgical coal is high-grade lignite coal **which has a special value for smelting iron in blast furnaces,** this statement is NOT correct.**
 
• Metallurgical coal**, also known as coking coal, is a high-quality hard coal (not lignite) used to produce coke, which is necessary for iron smelting in blast furnaces.**
 
• Metallurgical coal **needs to have low sulfur and phosphorus contents, making it much rarer and more valuable than thermal coal, which is used to produce heat and electricity.**
 
• **Typically, bituminous coal or anthracite is used for this purpose, not lignite, which is lower-grade coal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anthracite is the highest quality hard coal:**

 
 
• **Anthracite is indeed the highest grade of coal.**
 
• It's the oldest type of coal, having spent the most time underground exposed to pressure and heat.
 
• It's very hard and shiny** (hence "hard coal") and burns cleanly with little soot, making it much cleaner than other types of coal.**
 
• It's less common than other forms, which makes it more expensive.
 
 
 
• **Coal that has been buried deep and subjected to increased temperatures is bituminous coal:**
 
 
• Bituminous coal is a medium-rank coal between sub-bituminous coal and anthracite.
 
• It has been subjected to higher pressures and temperatures than lignite and sub-bituminous coal, but not as much as anthracite.
 
• **Bituminous coal is commonly used for generating electricity and heating in industrial processes.**
 
 
 
• **Lignite is a low-grade brown coal, which is soft with high moisture content:**
 
 
• Lignite, often referred to as brown coal, is indeed a low-grade coal.
 
• **It's softer than bituminous coal or anthracite, and it has a high moisture content.**
 
• This makes it less energy-dense and more polluting than higher-grade coals.
 
• **Lignite is often used in electricity production in power plants located near mining sites.**
